summary: Master Real Estate Joint Ventures. Learn waterfall modeling, GP/LP structures, and partnership governance to optimize property investments. Enroll today.
lede: Real estate joint venture training covers how professionals structure and assess shared property investments. It is for people who manage, analyze, or arrange these collaborations, and addresses practical tasks such as drafting term sheets, modeling capital waterfalls and returns, and conducting financial, legal, and market due diligence.
audienceIntro: This course targets professionals who structure, manage, or analyze real estate collaborations.
prerequisites: Prior experience in real estate investment or development is recommended, along with basic knowledge of financial modeling and legal agreements.
